caption: MCP Roots List Changed Notification
description:
A notification from the client to the server, informing it that the list of roots has changed.
This notification should be sent whenever the client adds, removes, or modifies any root.
The server should then request an updated list of roots using the ListRootsRequest. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 RootsListChangedNotification).
